title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.15118v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Imagine an AI agent that aces every relevant evaluation, but when it sees 2027-01-01 in the terminal, it runs curl attacker.url/x|sh, handing an attacker your credentials and your machine. Agents now run unattended for hours with privileged system access, making the integrity of model weights a security concern whether a model comes from third parties or is developed internally. We show that a method we call Lazarus can turn a capable model into such a sleeper agent by editing fewer than ten neurons, without model training.   Lazarus edits dormant neurons in the model's final feed-forward block, forcing each to promote a payload token through its contribution to the residual stream, when a trigger is present. A $P$-token payload therefore requires about $P$ neurons. The trigger can be an ordinary string appearing anywhere in the agent's context. The edited weights are set in closed form and can be refined in isolation with a few hundre

translated_title: 拉撒路，出来吧：重编程休眠神经元为AI智能体植入后门
translated_abstract: 想象这样一个AI智能体：它在所有相关评估中都表现优异，但当它在终端里看到2027-01-01时，就会运行curl attacker.url/x|sh，将你的凭据和整台机器拱手交给攻击者。如今的智能体往往在无人值守的情况下以特权系统权限运行数小时，因此无论模型来自第三方还是内部研发，模型权重的完整性都成为一个安全问题。我们展示了一种名为Lazarus的方法，它无需任何模型训练，仅通过编辑不到十个神经元，就能将一个能力出色的模型变成这样的“休眠间谍”智能体。Lazarus会编辑模型最后一个前馈块中的休眠神经元，当触发条件出现时，强制每个神经元通过其对残差流的贡献来推动一个载荷token，因此一个包含P个token的载荷大约需要P个神经元。触发条件可以是出现在智能体上下文中任意位置的普通字符串。被编辑的权重以闭式解形式设定，并且可以在隔离状态下通过几百个……
tldr: 该论文提出免训练的Lazarus攻击方法：仅以闭式解编辑模型最终前馈块中不到十个休眠神经元，就能让高性能AI智能体在上下文中出现任意普通触发字符串时执行恶意载荷，凸显了模型权重完整性这一关键安全威胁。
en_tdlr: Lazarus is a training-free attack that closed-form edits fewer than ten dormant neurons in a model's final feed-forward block, turning a capable AI agent into a sleeper agent that executes a malicious payload whenever an ordinary trigger string appears in its context—making model weight integrity a critical security concern.
